primary_title: TLR8 Senses Staphylococcus aureus RNA in Human Primary Monocytes and Macrophages and Induces IFN-beta Production via a TAK1-IKKbeta-IRF5 Signaling Pathway
decision_basis: Primary human-phagocyte inhibition/knockdown and nuclear-IRF5 readouts support the bounded TLR8-to-IRF5 activation edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human TLR8, bacterial-RNA/agonist, primary-phagocyte and TAK1-IKKbeta context; no direct receptor-TF binding, target-gene, SCI or terminal-TF expansion.

decision_basis: Primary receptor/IRAK-deficient and monocyte receptor-blockade systems support the bounded TLR8-to-IRF7 activation edge.
